title: Source binding is evidence, not executable template code
summary: Facts need source revisions; StringTemplate must not execute arbitrary Rexx methods.
semantics: Typed facts may originate from inventories, test runs or digests and carry source, revision and author.
DocyRef binds a node or cell to a fact; unknown refs display unresolved markers and WARN.
Expressions like {d~Version} require an explicit scoped property resolver, not evaluation of arbitrary Rexx.
Reuse StringTemplate's safe parsed language and frozen formatter snapshots only after qualification.
Real source adapters and freshness policies remain unimplemented; existing source references are fixture data.
